entry.title: New: dsh-desktop-launcher
entry.summary: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints. Exact install spec: github:yvesgao/dsh-desktop-launcher. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
